reader.label: Subexponential bound in k log k for binary coefficients
reader.title: Binary-coefficient integer linear programming under ETH

sources.locator: Theorem 1, p. 19:4, and proof in §2.3, pp. 19:9–19:10

bounds.statement: Under ETH, no deterministic algorithm decides the reported binary-coefficient feasibility problem within the stated running time.

sourceBasis.step: The source excludes this running time already when the number of columns and the largest right-hand side entry are O(k log₂ k), with a nonnegative right-hand side. These instances are valid inputs to the general binary-coefficient task, so the same running time is excluded for an algorithm on that task.

bounds.statement: Under FPT ≠ W[1], no deterministic algorithm decides feasibility of Ax=b for the stated all-ones right-hand side within the stated running time.

sources.role: Set Cover construction underlying the exact-cover encoding

source.role: Set Cover construction underlying the exact-cover encoding

sourceBasis.step: In Lin’s construction, the universe size equals the Set Cover budget times the common set size. A cover within budget is therefore an exact cover, and each exact cover meets the budget. The binary incidence matrix encodes exact cover as Ax=1 with a nonzero column for every set. Its O(h³ log n) rows allow the effective exponent cutoff to give a fixed-parameter algorithm for Multicolored Clique.

encoding: A signed integer matrix A with k rows and ℓ columns and a signed integer vector b of length k, all entries encoded in binary.

inputConditions.condition: Every entry of A is either zero or one.
The vector b is nonnegative, and both the number of columns ℓ and the maximum entry of b are O(k log₂ k).
Every entry of the right-hand side b equals one.
Every column of A has a nonzero entry. Consequently every feasible coordinate of x is zero or one.

parameter: The number of rows of A k.

reader.parameter: The number of rows of A k.

symbols.meaning: total bit length of the input
fixed nonnegative exponent of the complete input length

task: Does there exist a vector x of ℓ nonnegative integers satisfying Ax=b?
title: Integer Linear Programming Feasibility by number of equality constraints

recoveryAssessments.comparison: The all-ones incidence matrices are valid inputs to the binary-coefficient task with general right-hand sides. The exclusion on those matrices gives a logarithmic-scale recovery for that task, with computable convergence cutoffs and a fixed polynomial input factor.

evidence.role: Set Cover construction underlying the exact-cover encoding

recoveryDispositions.reason: The construction can use more than O(k log₂ k) columns, even with the right-hand side all ones. It does not give a recovery for the restricted ETH target with the column cap.
